    Finite skeletons of indecomposable modules #

    Representation-finiteness is stated using a finite family which may contain repetitions. Auslander--Reiten constructions require an actual finite skeleton. This file quotients such a family by module isomorphism, chooses one representative of every quotient class, and equips the resulting finite index with its induced full linear category.

    Type (v + 1)

    A finite skeleton of the finite-dimensional indecomposable left A-modules.

    • n : ℕ
    • obj : Fin self.n → ModuleCat A
    • obj_finite (i : Fin self.n) : Module.Finite k ↑(self.obj i)
    • obj_indecomposable (i : Fin self.n) : CategoryTheory.Indecomposable (self.obj i)
    • eq_of_iso {i j : Fin self.n} : Nonempty (self.obj i ≅ self.obj j) → i = j
    • complete (M : ModuleCat A) : IsFiniteIndecomposable k A M → ∃ (i : Fin self.n), Nonempty (M ≅ self.obj i)
